Class OrderingTrendsPage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
OrderingTrendsPage
public class OrderingTrendsPage extends Manager.Page
Manager page with sales reports for a date range: order count, revenue, average order, a chart of orders over time and the sales of each menu item, filtered by drink category. Also opens today's X-report.
Author:
Matthew Rogers
